To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the Dr. Inventor Framework can be effectively employed for the extraction of semantic and structural information from scientific publications; (2) the RDF dataset generated by the Framework can be used to support the analysis of scientific literature; and (3) the visualizations of the RDF dataset are useful to ease the exploration of scientific knowledge.
we developed an innovative framework for scientific text analysis that allows the extraction and characterization of scientific knowledge from papers.

1) we have developed a platform to automatically mine and model scientific publications; 2) we have evaluated the effectiveness of the Text Mining Framework in two core text analysis tasks; 3) we have developed Web visualizations to support the exploration of the extracted scientific knowledge; 4) we have released the mined datasets and the Web interfaces to facilitate the access to the mined knowledge.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and application of Natural Language Processing techniques to the extraction of knowledge from scientific papers and the semantic representation and visualization of the extracted information.
the development of a platform to extract and characterize scientific publications, as well as to support the exploration of the extracted knowledge.
the development of novel techniques to support the extraction of knowledge from scientific papers, and the generation of visualizations to ease the exploration of this knowledge.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach and tools provide a solid and effective basis for the extraction and representation of scientific knowledge from scientific publications.
our approach is able to automatically extract a wide range of semantic information from scientific publications, and to represent it using RDF datasets.

the Dr Inventor platform has been successfully applied to the ACL-IJCNPL 2015 conference, and that it is able to extract and represent a large amount of information from scientific articles, including the most relevant aspects of the scientific content, the most relevant aspects about the authors and the papers themselves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an automated platform to extract and characterize scientific knowledge from papers.
we have built a platform for knowledge extraction and modeling from the scientific publications, which is publicly available and can be used by the research community.
the Dr. Inventor platform allows the extraction of a large amount of information from the scientific literature, which is made easily accessible to the interested actors
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of the proposed methodologies, tools and Web visualizations allows to automatically extract, represent and visualize several facets of the scientific knowledge contained in a set of scientific publications, thus easing the exploration and understanding of the scientific literature by any interested party.
the proposed platform can be a valuable support to the analysis of scientific literature, by providing a set of tools and resources to ease its exploration.
the proposed approach can be easily extended to other scientific conferences, as well as to other scientific fields.
